title: Yaya's Beach Cottage | KEY.co
meta_description: Wrap around views in the heart of town
description_expanded: This stunning location in Rosemary Beach captures wide views of the sparkling blue gulf waters from several balconies. Boardwalk F is adjacent to this beach cottage, providing direct access to the beach or the nearby Western Green. Water Street House has four bedrooms with five full baths and offers three levels of living space. On the first floor, you'll find three bedrooms all with ensuite bathrooms: the master suite, bedroom 2, and the bunk room that easily sleeps three. The second level presents the open living, dining, and kitchen plus media room. The centerpiece of this home is the large wrap-around balcony that spans the width of the home. Arranged on the third level is a large guest bedroom with an ensuite bath and a private balcony offering its occupants amazing gulf views. Designed by Tom Christ, this large Rosemary Beach corner lot offers expansive balconies and porches enjoyed from copious French doors. The Rosemary Beach Town Center is only a block away offering shops and restaurants. You'll have gate access to the four community pools and beaches.
